Canvas Commands and History
|-- [M] Shared editing boundary
|   |-- MappingDocumentController: semantic commands + observable canvas snapshot
|   |   |-- Public: applyUpdate/transact, commitEditorGesture, undo/reset, CanvasView commands
|   |   |-- Public: prepare transfers, compare views, export history, read persistence changes
|   |   `-- Private: operation dispatch, staged node correspondence, snapshot/cache/listeners
|   |-- CanvasHistoryService: context-scoped access to history
|   |   |-- Controller depends on this interface; implementation can be injected
|   |   |-- DefaultCanvasHistoryService delegates to CanvasHistory
|   |   `-- Transport callers export records; they must not interpret revision tables
|   |-- CanvasHistory: checkpoints, revision bindings, navigation, named views
|   |   |-- Private record + validation cache + incremental checkpoint encoder
|   |   `-- Depends on diagram revision registry/editor and document validators
|   |-- Composition machinery: GridBox edits -> layout -> projection
|   |   `-- Depends on diagram contents, connections, selections and presentation settings
|   `-- Browser and headless use the same domain history
|       |-- Mounted editor attaches one driver for gesture settlement and native undo
|       `-- Headless proposals retain history without an editor driver
|
|-- [O] Who retains which state
|   |-- Runtime context lifetime
|   |   |-- Service creates CanvasHistory + a frozen CanvasEditingContext handle
|   |   |-- Private WeakMap keys histories by handle identity, not contextId alone
|   |   |   `-- Two viewers of the same saved context remain isolated; handles allow GC
|   |   `-- Runtime handles and service instances are excluded from saved canvases
|   |-- CanvasHistoryRecord owns navigation and retained history
|   |   |-- baselineId + headId + past/future checkpoint IDs
|   |   |-- snapshots: checkpoint ID -> StoredCanvasSnapshot
|   |   `-- diagramRevisions: revision ID -> immutable DiagramRevision
|   |-- Each checkpoint separates four concerns
|   |   |-- diagramBindings: content ID -> exact diagram revision ID
|   |   |-- document: composition and semantic presentation state
|   |   |   |-- GridBox root, canonical edges, sections and jumps
|   |   |   `-- Alternatives, presentations, agent contexts, selections and reviews
|   |   |-- view: personal MappingCanvasState
|   |   |   |-- Camera, selection, per-instance diagram views and floating display state
|   |   |   `-- Controls/surfaces are separate from the display ownership tree
|   |   `-- nodeOrigins + optional unresolved anchors preserve identity/staleness
|   |-- Saved CanvasViews belong to the history header
|   |   |-- Named checkpoint sequences, ancestry, working copies and generation status
|   |   `-- Undo or applying a saved endpoint does not restore this metadata
|   |-- A placement and its diagram have distinct identities
|   |   |-- duplicate-instance creates a new GridBox that shares contentId
|   |   `-- Each instance can retain its own collapsed-subtree view
|   `-- Retention and transport
|       |-- Checkpoints retain bound revisions plus alternative/review/selection dependencies
|       |-- currentOnly export keeps head dependencies and records omitted parent boundaries
|       |-- Saved views or an active recording force full-history export
|       |-- fork creates a new context/baseline, resets navigation, removes active recording
|       `-- persistenceChanges(since) returns header + changed records + encoded storage
|
|-- [C] Apply a semantic edit
|   |-- API: transact -> applyUpdate -> settle pending editor gesture
|   |   `-- Clear pending node map; call applyOperations; return version + display nodes
|   |-- Native gesture: commitEditorGesture -> applyOperations with gesture canvas state
|   |   `-- Selection-only gesture can directly record the updated canvas state
|   `-- applyOperations(expectedVersion, operations)
|       |-- Reject stale controller version or invalid batch size
|       |-- Clone current document + canvas; run operations in order on staged state
|       |   |-- Diagram content: create, insert, patch, replace, receive a revision
|       |   |   |-- Content edits issue revisions; later operations see earlier staged edits
|       |   |   `-- Track node correspondence; rebase affected anchors, jumps and views
|       |   |-- Composition: move/group/collapse/remove/duplicate placements
|       |   |   |-- Grid positions use cells; floating positions use pixels
|       |   |   `-- Native grid moves defer layout until the batch finishes
|       |   |-- Meaning/presentation: mappings, contexts, highlights, edges and jumps
|       |   `-- Alternatives/reviews: store, select, review and apply candidate revisions
|       |       `-- Relevant operations also check expected revision, hash or node identity
|       |-- Prune obsolete contexts/alternatives; validate projection; repair active focus
|       `-- updateSnapshot(record = true)
|           |-- Normalize selections and diagram views; reconcile connections/jumps
|           |-- Resolve floating geometry and validate connections
|           |-- historyService.append -> CanvasHistory.append
|           |   |-- Validate document and revision references before publishing checkpoint
|           |   |-- Bind exact revisions, retain dependencies, encode logical edge anchors
|           |   `-- Save document + view; push old head to past; set head; clear future
|           `-- Publish controller snapshot, advance version, notify subscribers
|               |-- One successful command batch/gesture produces one checkpoint
|               `-- Transient updateCanvas/layout changes can skip history and version
|
|-- [C] Navigate checkpoints and named alternatives
|   |-- undo/redo
|   |   |-- Mounted editor -> editor driver -> restore archived semantic checkpoint
|   |   |-- Headless controller -> service.navigate -> CanvasHistory.navigate
|   |   |   `-- Validate target; move IDs between past/future; restore document + view
|   |   `-- Transaction-linked navigation is rejected locally; use workspace transfer undo
|   |-- reset -> append a fresh checkpoint containing the baseline state
|   |-- Saved CanvasView workflow
|   |   |-- create -> pin current head; save -> advance the named saved endpoint
|   |   |-- open -> stash departing working copy; resume target working copy or saved end
|   |   |   `-- Create a fresh checkpoint while retaining the current camera
|   |   |-- fork -> child from parent's saved endpoint, then open child
|   |   |-- alternatives -> independent children of ONE pinned saved endpoint
|   |   |   `-- Group creation does not switch the active canvas
|   |   |-- keep -> save chosen child; archive group siblings and their descendants
|   |   |-- discard -> archive target and descendants; delete only permits a leaf
|   |   |-- Legacy recording: start -> collect visited checkpoints -> stop and save
|   |   |   `-- cancel removes recording metadata while keeping edits
|   |   `-- Legacy apply -> fresh checkpoint of saved endpoint, without transfer linkage
|   |-- Generation uses isolated proposals
|   |   |-- startGeneration -> pin parent saved state and register candidate views
|   |   |-- updateGeneration checks candidate run/chat identity and settlement status
|   |   `-- Finished proposal -> validate/import revisions and advance candidate endpoint
|   |       `-- Live head stays in place; opening the candidate is a separate action
|   `-- Comparison and dirty state
|       |-- canvasViewComparison reads only pinned start/final checkpoints
|       |-- promote-diffs adds diagram alternatives while retaining original checkpoints
|       `-- Dirty comparison excludes camera and selection, but includes other view state
|
|-- [C] Transfer diagrams across canvases
|   |-- Controller -> service -> prepareCanvasTransfer on isolated histories
|   |   |-- Require distinct canvases and a nonempty, unique selection of diagram boxes
|   |   |-- Preserve relative placement; map box/content identities and rebase annotations
|   |   |-- copy
|   |   |   |-- Allocate fresh box/content identities; leave source history unchanged
|   |   |   `-- Copy only edges whose two endpoints are selected; remap their anchors
|   |   `-- move
|   |       |-- Reuse identities unless destination collisions require new ones
|   |       |-- Remove selected placements; retain contents still used by source boxes
|   |       |-- Convert source edges into CanvasJumps, assigned by edge-source location
|   |       `-- Retarget links toward moved diagrams to the destination canvas
|   |-- Place group in destination; append destination checkpoint
|   |   |-- Move also appends source checkpoint
|   |   `-- Link affected checkpoints to transaction ID
|   |-- Return prepared source/destination states + before/after checkpoint IDs
|   |   `-- Workspace transaction owns publication of the prepared result
|   `-- prepareTransferNavigation for undo/redo
|       |-- Both canvas heads must match the transaction's expected boundaries
|       |   `-- Otherwise reject: newer edits must be undone first
|       `-- Navigate destination and, for move, source; return updated transaction state
|
`-- [D] What a resolved/rendered canvas actually needs
    |-- ResolvedCanvasDocument = checkpoint composition + bound diagram revisions
    |   |-- diagramBindings + diagramRevisions -> scene.contents [shared revisions]
    |   |-- Stored GridBox root + scene.contents -> LineGridScene
    |   `-- Canonical edge node references + bound revision.nodeRefs -> concrete anchors
    |       |-- Resolved anchors carry the current bound content revision ID
    |       `-- Legacy unresolved anchors remain explicitly stale
    |-- Layout/ASCII = placement tree + selected content + size constraints
    |   |-- resolveScene: parent offsets -> absolute bounds
    |   |   |-- Expanded diagram -> measure diagram ASCII
    |   |   |-- Expanded container -> aggregate children and minimum size
    |   |   `-- Collapsed box -> summary content; children are hidden
    |   |-- layoutScene: anchor changed subtree; settle siblings in stable spatial order
    |   |   `-- Push colliding siblings right using configured gap; validate final bounds
    |   `-- composeScene: resolved bounds + content -> painted ASCII rows
    |       `-- Reject overlaps, invalid ASCII, out-of-range extents or excessive cell count
    |-- Display nodes = resolved document + personal view + version + measurements
    |   `-- Controller caches by snapshot identity and returns a clone
    `-- Saved comparison = start checkpoint + final checkpoint + each endpoint's revisions
        `-- Reads immutable dependencies directly; does not navigate the live canvas
